title: Polar motion and length of day

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: Compute polar motion m, its rate, and the change in length of day, for the same loads and time history as tests 1/2 and 2/2, with the load centroid moved off the pole.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of gia_mip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.

not_converted.GS: T02-03/ holds lod_GS.dat, k2_GS.dat and the LOD/ files. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not polar motion or length of day, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.VB: T02-03/ holds M3-L70-V01_t02-03_{cap,disc,point}_{cwoff,cwon}.txt and the PM tables. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not polar motion or length of day, so this test has no reader yet.

status: not converted: no result class holds polar motion or length of day.
